title: Board protocol version
description: The board protocol version a message follows, as major.minor. A receiver supports major 1 and accepts any of its minors (design decision 2). Every message refuses the fields it does not define, so a receiver still on an older minor refuses a newer minor's field as a schema error: a minor only adds optional fields, and a sender sends a new field only once both receivers, the board page and board-host, accept it.
